literal: Self-control among the immortals will lead; lack of self-control into deep darkness having led will leave.
translation: Self-control will lead one to the realm of the immortals, while the lack of self-control will lead and plunge one into deep darkness.
modern: அடக்கம் ஒருவரைத் தேவர்களுள் கொண்டு சேர்க்கும்; அடக்கமில்லாமை அவரைப் பேரிருளில் கொண்டு சேர்த்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts the ultimate destinations of self-control and the lack of it. The word 'அடக்கம்' (self-control) is shown as an active force that elevates a person to the level of 'அமரர்' (immortals or highly respected beings). Conversely, 'அடங்காமை' (the absence of restraint) drags a person down into 'ஆரிருள்' (deep, dense darkness), symbolizing ignorance, misery, and ruin. The poet uses the verb root 'உய்' (to lead or direct) in both lines to emphasize that our inner discipline actively guides our destiny.
